description: A fan of red frills that keeps twitching after it is cut. Voidmaw breathes through a hundred of them.
lore: The twitch runs out along the fan and back again, and it slows on a schedule steady enough to sell. Fresh, about twice a breath. By evening, once in ten. Nothing by morning. Which makes a fan off [[monsters/eldritch_maw|the ringed mouth]] lying in a road a clock: something was broken here, and you can say within the hour how long ago, and from that how far ahead of you the party is and roughly what kind of day they are having. Fen-walkers read one off the ground without breaking stride. It works about as well as anything out there works, and it is the only good reason anyone has to be glad of the twitching, which is otherwise the least popular thing in the bag.
gm_notes: A clock the players can read. Drop a twitching fan in a corridor or on a road and the party can time the group ahead of them; a still one means hours, which is its own problem.
